name: trip_fall
text: A person walks forward, suddenly trips over an obstacle with the leading foot, and falls forward. The torso pitches forward, both arms shoot out in front to break the fall, knees hit the ground, then the body lands face down on the ground. End lying prone with hands near the shoulders. One continuous forward trip and fall, stay on the floor.
repair: Preserve body timing and pose; horizontal finger direction for low hands. Regenerate, never edit final motion arrays.

review.notes_zh: 迈步被绊、双臂前撑后俯卧，未另交同义fall。先修低处手掌朝向，再修趾端落地角度，全身关键帧保留原过程重新生成；仍有落地瞬间左膝骨架点最低约-3.7厘米，不能宣称全身零穿地。
review.review_frame_convention: review.png uses final delivered clip frame indices, beginning at 0.
